Services

Subscription vs. project work.

  • SaaS Monthly / annual subscription
  • Basic onboarding Included or low-cost
  • Data migration Project fee
  • Custom workflow or integration Project fee
  • Website or mobile app Project fee
  • Digital marketing, SEO / GEO Monthly retainer
  • Dedicated hosting, priority support Add-on

Honest limits

What we'll never bundle as 'unlimited'.

Low prices stay low because these are usage-based.

  • Unlimited customisation
  • Unlimited AI
  • Unlimited WhatsApp
  • Unlimited storage
